book.name: Yonna Yesusmoa.
book.title: Yonna Yesusmoa. Yonmba Ishomnavna Yesusm, Sesoana Ombolm.

content: Honmeva Nis Lohvna, Yesusva Doara Phona.
Minguram Maria Maktalava gavna pokamaram, wo nonamba mendah kilvrilvna simba. Mariava nonglavna nom hon mendeklim, ona, pai doa honmba ahnam vileilv kewulva.

Mariava dandwonam velavravna dom Simon Pitaindam, eva mongom Yesustindirinim, nom ten Yesus hev mindnam und vevnam. Maria unna, anmundvema doa vindvi mendeklimba pokamariniva? Kava tit viv, hi dihi vindlihei hemba?
Wo vena, Pita eva he dandwonam evlarombtvna dom pokamaram.
Dandwonam evlarombtvna, henoi koho, henoi koho, wo heva os owal Pitamba kuvhoana. Wo owal hesna phona miva diva pokamarava.
Hev vithanamba, novvesiha ve pokamaramba. Nonglana, ona, owai, men kayenmba moanvilv, heva os owai, himba sihanamoa domba meramba.
Wo venamba, Simon Pita prona. Hev sihanamba pokamaram, nonglana, ona, men kayenmba moanvilv.
Hev vena, nom nonglana kayenm, ten Yesusna kum nona ningimninam. Nomba kayenmba mongawulmba moan evahilwolvnamoa, pepetowol velohvna, wo indakonda moanvehalohvna.
Wo eva henoi siha, ten hesna mi pronam. Himba nonglavna, ona, tanam doa Yesusva phoi.
Himba mendah levra epievnamoa honamba temurava tombaimomba, osva Yesusva si phovav henga pokamariniva.
Yesusva Yumna Velana Maria Maktalam.
Wo doa os henga himba engana deuvram.
Mariaoa di lohna ambara pokamara wena. Nonamba himba wivelohvpa, hev vithanamba, novvesiha ve pokamaram.
Himba nongalna, ovsongolnindrini samblava, doa vewol evei kayenmba dombal. Di ahavna, ten nolhra Yesusmindm vindilnam, mongova kusis avna, mongova mutengsis avna.
Hev ohosahmana, manara yimba wivev? Hev ophona, anmundvema kana mendeklim vindviva? Kava tit vev, hi dihi himba vindlihei hemba.
Nonamba Mariava honamba osva ona ishona, himba henga ona imharavhoana, nonglana, men lohv Yesusva. Wo heva os himba osva nengnamoa, memba Yesus, owai.

Yesus osahmana hem, omnana, manara yimba wivev? Wo anm yimba hevpa silelv memba? Mariava os nengvna, memba denwit andranindrini olohv. Wo hev omnana, wo es hevpa ye vendguaima mendeklimindmba? Ishomno kam, hi yimba vendpikai hemba, wo ata kava vendvevav henga hemba.
Yesus omnana, Maria, Mariava novlomossis imharavhoanamba Yesusindam, wo omnana Hiprumona, Raponi, osm uv, guru.
Yesus omnana hemba, ata ye kam kevravav. Kava mendah vongavmoa araindamba. Heva os gao, katindimoa ishunu honamoa. Kava henga gav yena kavna araindam. Kava henga gav yena kavna Sesoaindam.
Maria Maktalava ganamba, wo hev unna Yesustindim, kava nonglai doa mendeklimba. Wo eva hev vena, nom ishunna, ten Yesus hevm ishomnanam.
Yesusva Ambara Vithinvna Hevmba Hevtindimba.

Ambo nonamta minguram, okombava vohavnamba, Yesustindiva mongawaduvra mongawatilm kusonamba, di aevulvna. Tuvpa kolvowol vinamba keknam, noinda himba pem vivna Yutanindnapenam. Wo doa Yesusva pronamba, hovrahovra di lohvhueinnamba. Hev unna, yeoa beswonam undwonam ao.
Henanam himba honamba osva unnamba, doa vena, engla nethawolna hevna, eva almangm. Wo hevtindiva indk vethapravna, nonamba himba nunglivnamba mendeklimba.
Wo henga Yesus unna, yeoa beswonam undwonam ao. Ara kamba wolaihaprana, ka men eva yemba wolanga vungu vev.
Honamba himba osva ishopianamba, doa hevna vavatan povholothunnamba, unna, dumbu Sesoasongol.
Yimba selvhinvrava mongla indhanana indkoklamba, henamba os hoai vilunvra. Yimba selvhamba owai vinvrava, osva henamba wohluhunvra.
Yesusva Hevm Holvonethamnana Tomasm.
Tomas, eva mongova nihilva Ditimus, himba owalmongova aevulvnamoa, nonamba Yesusva provnamba. Tomasva mongo noi 12pelara, ten lovahvnam Yesustindi.

Wo mongla owal hevtindi umnina Tomasmba, kava doa nungli mendeklimba. Wo eva os Tomas ona, kava nengvmoa, heva boasna pakovholm englarinim ka nonglamnarava kavna novna. Wo kava si hellevavmoa, heva verava, boasna ka kavna englapund piasaharava di pakovholla, eva di almangsis bunevholla.

Wo mongona minguramba hevtindiva henga deuvra kusovna, wo Tomasmba di waiaevulvna nonamba nihra. Tuvpa doara kolvowol vina keknam, heva os Yesusva sihanamba, di hovrahovra lohvhueinnamba. Hev unna, yeoa beswonam undwonam ao.
Wo doa hev omnana Tomasm, lotho pevna englapund hui. Nonglo kana englam. Piasaho pevna engla hui kana almangshara. Wuleiho sambla undmoa, kamoa keknam undnahonam lohvhoamno.
Tomas omnana, yimba kana mendekli, yimba kana Sesoa.
Wo Yesus omnana, yimba noinda ov, ambo yimba kam nonglaiva. Himba nomba temba nonglamba novnamba owai vivpa, wo keknamba lovahmanavrava kamba, si tanamolnam indk vithivav.
Manaram Yonmba Moalamangnindriniva Novol Vena Hona Tombaiva?
Yesusva vewol vena mindnam monglava mendekliandrava hevtindina novrava, heva os novol velohvmoa hona tombairava.
Wo heva os memba novol velohv, osm yimba nonora avra, osva Yesusva Kristus lohv, Sesoana ombol. Undnahonam keknam lovahthamnallava, yimba osva avav undna hena nihilla.
